title: How to Install a Motion-Activated Security Light

locations.name: Exterior wall / Outdoor installation (probable)
locations.basis: Transcript describes drilling a hole to the outside, weatherproofing, outdoor wiring, and installing the light outside; filming location not specified

summary: This Old House illustrates a DIY exterior lighting upgrade by installing a motion-activated security light. The workflow includes selecting a dual-beam motion detector, preparing and routing power outside, assembling the fixture indoors, weatherproofing the exterior connection, and replacing an outlet with a motion-override switch. The host demonstrates the two-detector configuration (one forward at 180 degrees and one downward at 360 degrees), compares LED longevity with traditional bulbs, and uses a test mode to position and verify the beam before final night operation. The process emphasizes safety steps (power shutoff), outdoor sealing, and simple post-install testing to ensure the light activates with motion and can be overridden by a switch when desired.
topics: outdoor wiring from inside to outside
assembling fixture indoors before outdoor install
beams and sensor coverage (forward 180 degrees, downward 360 degrees)

sections.title: Intro and component overview
sections.description: The presenter introduces a motion detector unit with two detectors: one forward (180 degrees) and one aimed downward (360 degrees). He also introduces LED light modules and notes their long life compared with normal bulbs.

sections.title: Outdoor power prep and initial wiring task
concepts: replacing an outlet and drilling toward exterior
sections.description: Power is shut off at the breaker before removing the old outlet and cutting a hole to run wiring outdoors toward the new fixture.

sections.title: Fixture assembly indoors
sections.description: The light fixture is assembled inside the house prior to outdoor installation to simplify final assembly and weatherproofing steps.

sections.title: Exterior installation and weatherproofing
sections.description: Outside installation is accompanied by weatherproofing with flexible putty to seal the fixture and ducting from the elements.

sections.title: Override switch and outlet modification
sections.description: Inside the house, the existing outlet is replaced with a switch-over setup so the motion detector can be overridden if desired.

sections.title: Testing, beam alignment, and real-world operation
sections.description: Power is restored; the light activates when someone passes the sensor. The system is left in test mode to adjust the beam, with the expectation that it will operate automatically at night when motion is detected.
